title: Cluster new words by topic or shape
summary: Group words that share a topic, a measure word, or a component so one cue brings the others back.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: A list of eight unrelated words has eight separate ways to fail. Words that share a topic, a measure word, or a component give each other retrieval cues, so a group about the kitchen will recall a group about the kitchen and nothing else. Choose one grouping rule per session and say the rule in your notes, since mixing rules quietly makes a set harder than it needs to be. Keep a cluster to half a screen of words, then finish it and start a new one rather than growing it forever.
